tables.name: accounts
tables.comment: Vaullet's own record of a user: the identifier money is keyed to, and its status. Holds no personal data in either identity mode (ADR-006, ADR-014).

columns.name: account_id
columns.comment: Permanent. Keys seven years of immutable ledger journal, so it must outlive Keycloak, a realm re-import, or a change of identity provider.

columns.name: keycloak_sub
columns.comment: Keycloak user id. NULL = unlinked anchor: provisioned before the user ever authenticated. Set by just-in-time provisioning at first login.

columns.name: external_ref
columns.comment: The operator's own user id. Unique per deployment and immutable once set (ADR-012); immutability is enforced by the accounts_invariants trigger.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | CLOSED. Authoritative here, not in Keycloak: a fraud lock the operator's directory could overrule is not a fraud lock. CLOSED is terminal.

constraints.name: accounts_natural_key_ck
constraints.def: CHECK (((external_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (keycloak_sub IS NOT NULL)))

indexes.name: accounts_external_ref_uk
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_external_ref_uk ON identity_schema.accounts USING btree (external_ref)

indexes.name: accounts_keycloak_sub_uk
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_keycloak_sub_uk ON identity_schema.accounts USING btree (keycloak_sub)

indexes.name: accounts_pk
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX accounts_pk ON identity_schema.accounts USING btree (account_id)

triggers.name: accounts_invariants
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER accounts_invariants BEFORE UPDATE ON identity_schema.accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION identity_schema.accounts_enforce_invariants()

indexes.name: flyway_schema_history_pk
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX flyway_schema_history_pk ON identity_schema.flyway_schema_history USING btree (installed_rank)

indexes.name: flyway_schema_history_s_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX flyway_schema_history_s_idx ON identity_schema.flyway_schema_history USING btree (success)

tables.name: outbox
tables.comment: Events committed with the change they describe, delivered afterwards by the relay (#39). Each row is an ADR-007 envelope plus its delivery state. identity.account-created is delivered over HTTP as the ledger's POST /v1/wallets, REAL then BONUS, until there is Kafka.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: ADR-007 event_id. Consumers dedupe on it.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.comment: When the account was created: its created_at.

columns.name: producer_version
columns.comment: The build that wrote the row. NULL for rows V3 backfilled and for the demo seed.

columns.name: correlation_id
columns.comment: Trace id of the request that created the account, as in its error bodies. NULL where no request was at hand: backfilled, swept and seeded rows.

columns.name: causation_id
columns.comment: ADR-007 causation_id: the event_id of the event that caused this one. NULL for identity.account-created, which a request causes, not an event.

columns.name: queued_at
columns.comment: When the row was written. Later than occurred_at for rows queued after the account's own transaction: by V3's backfill or by the relay's sweep.

columns.name: next_attempt_at
columns.comment: When the entry is next due. Pushed a lease ahead when a relay claims it, a backoff ahead when an attempt fails.

columns.name: last_error
columns.comment: Why the last attempt failed. Kept after delivery.

columns.name: delivered_at
columns.comment: NULL until the work is done: for identity.account-created, both wallets exist in the ledger or were closed there.

indexes.name: outbox_account_created_uk
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_account_created_uk ON identity_schema.outbox USING btree (account_id) WHERE (event_type = 'identity.account-created'::text)

indexes.name: outbox_due_ix
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX outbox_due_ix ON identity_schema.outbox USING btree (next_attempt_at) WHERE (delivered_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: outbox_pk
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_pk ON identity_schema.outbox USING btree (event_id)
